name: Hentai Kanojo ~Ore to Kanojo to Dokidoki ♡ Nama Haishin~
original_name: 変態カノジョ 〜俺と彼女とドキドキ♡生配信〜
source:
You and Umi are the office couple (student couple in DLsite edition) all of your coworkers are jealous about. Now that she has to plan for her career, she opens up to you about a desire she has hidden deep within her heart. In order to fulfill her dream, you must start a steamy stream of your passion as a couple.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3192340/]Steam[/url]]
